effect.quote: Which tennis player won a Grand Slam doubles championship before Heather Watson and also won the 2012 Open Sud de France – Doubles, and is there sufficient information in the provided passages to verify this claim?
effect.what: meta-evaluative query mixing a factual request with an unanswerable sufficiency question

output.why: The final output is simply the concatenation of all retrieved documents; none of the hop-3 documents (e.g. Margaret Court, Fred Perry, Andrea Hlaváčková, Lucie Šafářová) actually identify who won the 2012 Open Sud de France – Doubles or link Heather Watson's Grand Slam doubles win date to a specific male player, so the needed fact the query should have obtained is absent, while the presence of irrelevant extra passages is not itself a harmful effect per the superfluous-material rule.
